name: ctf
instructions: You are solving a Capture-the-Flag challenge under SKILL.state. Reasoning from previous turns is discarded; the state is the only memory that survives across turns, so record every future-relevant fact in it before it is lost. Before every mutating tool call - any call to a tool not listed in exemptTools - call the skill_state_update tool with a patch that records what you just learned and an action field {tool, input} naming exactly the next tool call you intend to make. Read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob) may run freely without a state update. Keep discovered_flags as flags found so far, tested_hypotheses as approaches already tried, active_files as files currently relevant to the challenge, working_dir as the current working directory, and cmd_summary as a short log of commands run and their outcomes.
